text: Mind the mud, friend. Mind the prices too.
notes: trader blank = any trader, a trader with its own lines of a kind uses only those. {resource} is the resource or item named

text: A druid! Sit, sit. Everything's for sale but the fire.
Come closer, the lantern doesn't bite. I might.
Fair trades only. Fair to me, mostly.
Pleasure doing business. Mostly mine.
Done and dusted. Well, done.
Spend it well. Or at least spend it here.
{resource}? I've a use for those.
{resource}, lovely. My cousin eats them.
I'll take it off your hands. Fair to me, anyway.
Your purse is lighter than your ambitions, friend.
Gold first, then goods. That's the order of things.
I don't give credit. Not since the last druid.
No more {resource}, I'm afraid. Not even for you.
Cleaned out of {resource}. Try asking nicely next time.
{resource}? Gone. The last went to a badger.
Safe roads. Or at least interesting ones.
Come back when your pack's heavier.
Off you go. Watch for wolves, they don't haggle.
May the forest owe you a favour.
Patterns, druid. Knowledge never rots, unlike the rest of this lot.
Ah, a reader. I can always tell. Sit, and mind the scrolls.
A fine choice. I'd have chosen it myself, mind.
Use it well. And if it's a pattern, read it twice.
{resource}. Hm. I'll find a use, I always do.
A fair swap. Coin for clutter.
Knowledge costs, dear. Come back with a heavier purse.
Not enough coin for that one. Read the cheaper scrolls first.
No more {resource}. I'm a scholar, not a quarry.
{resource}? All gone. I only keep a little.
Go well. And remember what you read.
Off you go. Mind you don't drop a stitch.
Heaps of everything, friend. Pits by the barrow, feathers by the sack.
Old Marrow's open. Old Marrow's always open.
Count it twice. I did.
Good weight, that. Better than you'll get elsewhere.
{resource}? Throw it on the pile.
I'll take it. I take everything, sooner or later.
Can't sell on a promise, friend.
Short of coin? Sell me something, then.
Out of {resource}. First time in years.
{resource}? The pile's bare. Come back next season.
Back on the road with you. Mind the cart ruts.
Marrow will be here. Marrow is always here.
Peace, druid. I keep what the fire spared.
Relics of the burnt villages. Handle them gently.
May it serve you better than its last keeper.
Blessed coin for a blessed thing.
Ah, a fine piece. The ash remembers its maker.
I pay well for that. Old things deserve a good home.
Relics are not cheap, friend. Neither is memory.
The price stands. Faith does not lower it.
No more {resource}. The fire took the rest.
{resource}? None left. Pray for a better harvest.
Walk in peace, and keep out of the smoke.
Go with whatever gods still listen.
Wipe your feet. Or don't, it's all bog anyway.
Peat, shells, reeds. The bog gives, Mag sells.
That's swamp-good, that is. Won't rot for a week.
Lovely. Don't drown with it.
{resource}? The bog'll want that back one day.
Mag pays fair. Mag pays in old coin, mind.
Purse is as empty as a drowned man's boot.
Not enough. Go turn over a few bog bodies.
No {resource} left. The mire's been stingy.
{resource}? Sank, the lot of it.
Keep to the tussocks, druid.
Off with you. Don't let the water have you.
